reviews.body:
Nice catch, and thanks for digging into the Vertex retirement dates -- picking 3.8 over 3.6 for that reason is exactly right. I confirmed 3.8-flash is GA on both the Gemini API and Vertex, and that it resolves cleanly through the `gemini-3` prefix in ModelContextWindows, so the context window lookup still works.

Two tiny optional things, neither blocking:
- The class javadoc up top still uses `gemini-2.0-flash` as its example -- would be nice to sweep that too while you're here.
- Pinning a point-version default is what rotted last time. If the Gemini API has a floating `-latest` alias, defaulting to that would be self-healing -- but point-versions are more predictable, so your call.

Approving.
